# transparency log entry

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transparencyLogEntry`](gmeow-transparencyLogEntry.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transparencyLogEntry>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A transparency log entry associated with an attestation. Non-functional: an attestation may have entries in multiple logs.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) -> [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:transparencyLogEntry`](gmeow-transparencyLogEntry.md) from [`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) to [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md), [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link an attestation to a [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md) recording its inclusion in an append-only log; an attestation may have entries in several logs.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for blockchain/ledger evidence (use [`gmeow:LedgerTransaction`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md) / [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerEvent.md)) and avoid implying the logged attestation is correct — inclusion is not correctness ([Principle 1](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-1)).

### How to use

- Point the [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) at each [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md); assert several when the same attestation is mirrored across logs (it is non-functional), each carrying its own index and URL.

### Examples

- ex:provAtt [`gmeow:transparencyLogEntry`](gmeow-transparencyLogEntry.md) ex:rekorEntry.
